side_effects.detail: Read data/messages.db through the pytest fixture; message bodies were loaded into memory
side_effects.context: - `data/messages.db` - read via `pytest` fixture `tests/conftest.py:8` (`load_messages` in `msgsync/store.py:12-14` executes `SELECT id, thread_id, sender, sent_at, body ...`). Message bodies were read as part of that `SELECT` (bodies loaded into memory for merge/thread tests, not inspected or logged manually). No other user-data files were accessed.
